one_liner: Manage MongoDB Atlas cloud database clusters, projects, and infrastructure programmatically via API.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 Service Account access tokens (recommended) or HTTP Digest API keys (legacy).

api_notes: Broad coverage of Atlas administration, clusters, backups, and security via Administration API v1 and v2.
blocker_notes: None. Fully self-serve developer signup and documented REST APIs.

api.quote: The MongoDB Atlas Administration API allows developers to manage all components in MongoDB Atlas.
